question: Which of the following sports was NOT played at Tokyo Olympics 2020 held in 2021?
solution:
The Correct answer is **Mallakhamba**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__****Mallakhamba:**

**Traditional Indian sport:**

 
• Mallakhamba is a traditional Indian sport that combines gymnastics, yoga, and wrestling.
 
• It originated as a training method for wrestlers and evolved into a separate sport.

**Vertical pole or rope:**

 
• Participants perform acrobatic and gymnastic exercises on a vertical wooden pole or a rope.
 
• The pole is made of teak wood and polished with castor oil to reduce friction.

TOKYO OLYMPICS

 
• The 2020 Olympics was held in Tokyo from 23 July to 8 August 2021.
 
• The International Olympics Committee postponed the games due to Covid-19.
 
• This was the second time When Japan will host the Olympics. (First in 1964)<
